svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Contact, proximity and projection printing
svg.desc: Three panels. Contact: the mask sits on the resist and prints a sharp copy but is damaged by the contact. Proximity: a gap g separates mask and resist; diffraction blurs the edges over roughly the square root of wavelength times gap. Projection: a lens images the mask onto the wafer with resolution k1 lambda over NA. Below each panel, the light intensity reaching the resist is plotted against the mask pattern.
svg.text: A gap g protects the mask;
Schematic, not to scale. Dashed: mask pattern; solid: 1D scalar model (arbitrary units).
